scripts.check: bun run typecheck && biome check && bun scripts/check-imports.ts && bun scripts/check-cycles.ts
scripts.prepare: git rev-parse --git-path hooks >/dev/null 2>&1 && printf '#!/bin/sh\nexec bunx biome check --staged --no-errors-on-unmatched --diagnostic-level=error\n' > "$(git rev-parse --git-path hooks)/pre-commit" && chmod +x "$(git rev-parse --git-path hooks)/pre-commit" || true
